newsitem.title: USA: US corp debt issuers to test water amid stable mkt.
newsitem.headline: US corp debt issuers to test water amid stable mkt.

text.p: Issuers sidelined after Friday's sharp rise in U.S. Treasury yields are expected to step off the sidelines and test the waters once again as the market moves into more stable territory, dealers said.
"The tone in the market is positive...there is stability and this is what issuers on the sidelines have been waiting for," one high-grade syndicate source said.
On Friday, U.S. Treasuries dropped substantially following a stronger-than-expected December jobs report which sent the 30-year bond down by almost two full points and drove yields sharply higher.
